description: This file defines the MethodCallExpression class in Twig, which represents a method call node within Twig's template parsing and compilation process.

classes.name: MethodCallExpression
classes.description: Represents a method call expression node within Twig's expression parsing tree. Handles compilation of method calls, including supporting deprecated usage warnings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new MethodCallExpression node, setting attributes and handling deprecation warnings for old usage patterns.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to execute the method call, either checking for method existence or calling the macro method.
